# Install packages
```{r}
# Set up renv for reproducible package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("renv")
} else {
  message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load renv for environment management
library(renv)

# Activate renv if the project is not yet synchronized
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
  renv::activate()
}

# Restore the package environment (useful for collaborators)
renv::restore()

# Load required libraries for geospatial data handling and project paths
library(terra)      # For raster and vector data
library(here)       # For reproducible file paths
library(tidyterra)  # For tidyverse-style terra operations
```

# Load the processed data data
```{r}
# Define the base directory for processed data
data_dir <- here("Data", "processed")

# Specify subdirectories containing different geospatial datasets
folders <- c("Adm_boundaries", "DEM", "Facilities", "Flood_extents", 
       "Landcover", "OSM_roads", "Rainfall_estimation", 
       "water_lines", "Worldpop_density", "Worldpop_dev_indicators")

# Iterate over each folder to load geospatial files
for (folder in folders) {
  folder_path <- file.path(data_dir, folder)
  
  # List all files in the current folder (including subfolders)
  files <- list.files(folder_path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Identify vector files by extension (.shp, .geojson, .gpkg)
  vector_files <- files[grepl("\\.(shp|geojson|gpkg)$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(vector_files) == 1) {
  # Load a single vector file and assign to a variable named after the folder
  assign(folder, vect(vector_files[[1]]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  print(paste("Loaded single vector file into variable:", folder))
  } else if (length(vector_files) > 1) {
  # Load multiple vector files as a list and assign to a variable named after the folder
  assign(folder, lapply(vector_files, vect), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  print(paste("Loaded multiple vector files into list variable:", folder))
  }
  
  # Identify raster files by extension (.tif, .vrt)
  raster_files <- files[grepl("\\.(tif|vrt)$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(raster_files) == 1) {
  # Load a single raster file and assign to a variable named after the folder
  assign(folder, rast(raster_files[[1]]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  print(paste("Loaded single raster file into variable:", folder))
  } else if (length(raster_files) > 1) {
  # Load multiple raster files as a list and assign to a variable named after the folder
  assign(folder, lapply(raster_files, rast), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  print(paste("Loaded multiple raster files into list variable:", folder))
  }
}

# Clean up temporary objects from the environment
rm(files, vector_files, raster_files, folder_path, folder, data_dir, folders)
```
